description: Field-level contract of the K-SACCR Trades and NettingSets CSV input files, version 1. CSV_CONTRACT.md explains it; tools/csv_contract.py implements it.

format.encoding: UTF-8, with or without a byte-order mark

columns.name: netting_set_id
columns.description: Unique netting-set ID, compared case-insensitively; referenced by every trade.

columns.name: counterparty
columns.description: Descriptive counterparty name or identifier.

columns.name: margined
columns.description: Y for a supported margin agreement.

columns.name: clearing_role
columns.description: Bank's clearing role; MULTI is accepted by the file and makes the netting set INVALID in the engine.

columns.name: remargin_period_business_days
columns.description: Remargining every N business days; 0 is read as daily with a warning.

columns.name: large_or_illiquid
columns.description: Y applies the 20-business-day MPOR floor.

columns.name: margin_disputes
columns.description: Y doubles the MPOR.

columns.name: mpor_override_business_days
columns.description: MPOR in business days, applied only when not below the computed MPOR.

columns.name: variation_margin_net_amount
columns.description: Net variation margin: held positive, posted negative.

columns.name: independent_collateral_net_amount
columns.description: Net independent collateral amount.

columns.name: threshold_amount
columns.description: Margin threshold, unscaled.

columns.name: minimum_transfer_amount
columns.description: Minimum transfer amount, unscaled.

columns.name: alpha_factor
columns.description: Alpha for this netting set; a value other than 1.4 classifies the run WHAT-IF.

columns.name: regime_override
columns.description: Regime of this netting set and all its trades.

columns.name: margin_agreements
columns.description: MIXED or SHARED declares an unsupported structure, which the engine rejects.

columns.name: qccp
columns.description: Role CCP only, and then required: Y if the CCP is qualifying.

columns.name: ccp_retains_variation_margin
columns.sheet_header: CCP retains VM, collateral not protected (Y/N)
columns.description: Role CCP only, and then required: Y if the CCP retains VM and the collateral is not protected.

columns.name: trade_id
columns.description: Unique leg ID, compared case-insensitively.

columns.name: netting_set_id
columns.description: ID of the leg's netting set in NettingSets.

columns.name: asset_class
columns.description: Asset class; OT is CRR only.

columns.name: sub_class
columns.description: Regulatory sub-class, such as AAA or CQS3 for credit, SINGLE or INDEX for equity; required by the engine where the asset class needs one.

columns.name: risk_factor
columns.description: Currency, currency pair, reference entity or other hedging key.

columns.name: instrument
columns.description: Instrument type.

columns.name: direction
columns.description: Long or Short.

columns.name: option_type
columns.description: Call or Put; required by the engine for an option.

columns.name: nature
columns.description: Hedging-set nature.

columns.name: hedging_set_label
columns.description: Label of a basis or volatility hedging set; required by the engine for those.

columns.name: notional_amount
columns.description: Unscaled notional of this leg.

columns.name: notional_currency
columns.description: Currency of the notional.

columns.name: market_value_amount
columns.description: Mark-to-market of the leg; in an economic trade, only its MtM leg carries a value.

columns.name: market_value_currency
columns.description: Currency of the MtM.

columns.name: start_date
columns.description: Start date S.

columns.name: end_date
columns.description: End date E; after the start date when both are given.

columns.name: maturity_date
columns.description: Contractual maturity M.

columns.name: option_expiry_date
columns.description: Option expiry T; required by the engine for an option.

columns.name: underlying_price
columns.description: Option underlying price or rate P.

columns.name: strike_price
columns.description: Option strike K.

columns.name: lambda_price
columns.description: Lambda shift added to P and K.

columns.name: attachment_rate
columns.description: CDO tranche attachment point, a fraction.

columns.name: detachment_rate
columns.description: CDO tranche detachment point, a fraction above the attachment point.

columns.name: economic_trade_id
columns.blank: the row is a whole trade
columns.description: Groups the legs of one economic trade.

columns.name: mtm_leg
columns.description: Y on the one leg of an economic trade that carries its whole MtM.

columns.name: settlement_type
columns.description: STM for a settled-to-market trade.

columns.name: next_reset_date
columns.description: STM only, and then required: the first settlement date after the reporting date.

columns.name: comment
columns.description: Free-text note; not read by the engine.

errors.CSV-ENCODING: The file is not valid UTF-8 or contains a NUL character.
errors.CSV-SYNTAX: The record is not valid CSV: a quote inside an unquoted field, text after a closing quote, a lone CR, or a quoted field left open at the end of the file.
errors.CSV-EMPTY: The file has no header record.
errors.CSV-DELIMITER: The header is a single field that contains a comma or a tab: the file uses another delimiter than ';'.
errors.CSV-HEADER-DUPLICATE: A column name appears more than once in the header.
errors.CSV-HEADER-MISSING: A column of the contract is missing from the header.
errors.CSV-HEADER-UNKNOWN: The header names a column that is not in the contract.
errors.CSV-FIELD-COUNT: The record has a different number of fields from the header.
errors.CSV-BLANK-RECORD: Every field of the record is blank.
errors.CSV-TOO-MANY-RECORDS: The file has more records than the contract allows.
errors.CSV-TOO-LARGE: The file has more bytes than the contract allows.
errors.CSV-TYPE: The field does not have the form its type requires.
errors.CSV-RANGE: The value is outside the range the contract allows.
errors.CSV-ALLOWED: The value is not one of the allowed values.
errors.CSV-LENGTH: The text is longer than its type allows.
errors.CSV-FORMULA: Text may not start with =, +, -, @, a tab or a carriage return.
errors.CSV-DUPLICATE-KEY: The key repeats an earlier record of the file, compared case-insensitively.
errors.CSV-ROW-RULE: The record breaks a rule between its fields.
errors.CSV-NETTING-SET-UNKNOWN: The leg's netting set is not on NettingSets.
errors.CSV-ECON-MTM-LEG: An economic trade does not have exactly one MtM leg, or a whole trade is flagged N.
errors.CSV-ECON-MTM-VALUE: A leg that is not the MtM leg of its economic trade has a MtM other than 0.
errors.CSV-ECON-NETTING-SET: The legs of an economic trade are in different netting sets.
errors.CSV-ECON-SETTLEMENT: The legs of an economic trade differ in settlement type or next reset date.
errors.CSV-ECON-ASSET-CLASS: Two legs of an economic trade are in the same asset class and not both options.
errors.CSV-CONTEXT-PARAMS: Params, the supervisory-factor table or the FX table cannot be read as a run reads them, so the rules that depend on them are not judged.
errors.CSV-CONTEXT-MATURED: The trade's maturity, or else its end date or option expiry, is not after the reporting date.
errors.CSV-CONTEXT-EXPIRED: The option's expiry is not after the reporting date.
errors.CSV-CONTEXT-RESET: The next reset date of an STM trade is not after the reporting date.
errors.CSV-CONTEXT-CURRENCY: The notional or MtM currency has no rate in the FX table.
errors.CSV-CONTEXT-PAIR: A currency of the FX pair has no rate in the FX table.
errors.CSV-CONTEXT-FACTOR: The supervisory-factor table has no row for the asset class and sub-class.
errors.CSV-CONTEXT-REGIME: The asset class or its supervisory factor is not available under the netting set's regime.

portfolio_rules.description: Each leg's netting set is on NettingSets, compared case-insensitively.
An economic trade has exactly one leg with MtM leg Y; a whole trade has Y or blank.
In an economic trade, every leg but the MtM leg has a MtM of 0.
The legs of an economic trade are in one netting set.
The legs of an economic trade have one settlement type (blank read as N) and one next reset date.
Two legs of an economic trade in the same asset class are both options.

context_rules.description: The maturity, or else the end date, or else the option expiry, is after the reporting date.
An option that has not matured expires after the reporting date.
The next reset date of an STM trade is after the reporting date.
The notional and MtM currencies have a rate in the FX table; a blank one is the reporting currency, or for the MtM the notional currency.
Both currencies of an FX pair have a rate in the FX table.
The supervisory-factor table has a row for the trade: IR, FX or OT, or the asset class and sub-class, such as CR_AAA.
Under the netting set's regime, its override or else the Params regime, OT is CRR-only and a factor row limited to a regime is that regime.
